name: Fodni Bhaat (Indian Fried Rice)

ingredients.name: green Thai chiles, stemmed and halved lengthwise

instructions.primary_message: In a medium cast iron skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat until shimmering. Reduce heat to medium heat, add black mustard seeds, and cook, stirring, until seeds pop, about 15 seconds. Add garlic and green chiles and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 2 minutes, adjusting heat as needed if garlic is browning. Add turmeric and chile powder and stir until they impart their color to the oil, about 10 seconds. Immediately add rice and stir until thoroughly coated with oil. Season with salt to taste. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.

schema_metadata.keywords: fried rice, garlic, quick, rice, vegetables revised

description: Fodni Bhaat is a quick and easy rice dish that can be made in a hurry. It's doubles up as both a lunch and breakfast dish and is a great way to use up leftover white rice from last night's dinner.
notes:
Optional substitutions: green Thai chiles → 2 serrano peppers

Notes: Rice should either be cooked fresh, spread on a tray, and allowed to cool for five minutes, or, alternatively, cooked in advance and refrigerated in a covered container for at least 12 hours and up to 3 days.
author: Denise D'silva Sankhé
